chunks: O people of the Book, why do you mix the false with the true, and hide the truth knowingly?
ai.seo_question: Why did the People of the Book mix truth with falsehood according to this Quranic verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a critique of the People of the Book for distorting the Torah to obscure the prophecy of Imam Muhammad (peace be upon him). It underscores the concept of *tahrif* (distortion) not merely as textual alteration but as the deliberate concealment of clear signs by those who possess prior knowledge.
